review.root: Read full native snapshot and neutral stamped-group implementations/tests/docs and independent reviews. Accepted exact explicit child-module correction. Combined review confirms actual native Q and typed finite S automatically include enlarged neutral core/stamp/slot types; H derives from actual CaptureRunHostPlan. Native snapshots remain existing-only and never install the neutral group or claim freshness. Final capacity fixture preserves construction-time physical parameter oracle and exact foreign-plan alias custody with only nine original visibility edits. Source-only manifest/full replay, ordered docs and all fourteen new plus one updated test entries were checked. Central validation pending. Root reviewed separate two-path cold fixture rebind overlay. Quiet executes custom traversal and invalidates the actual prepared token. The later snapshot fixture now first asserts BindingMismatch, explicitly uses the existing cold rebind, validates the same shared source and then tests missing new KV publication. All original snapshot, exact-account, rejection and teardown assertions are retained; no production token policy changes. Central compilation corrected two new fixture teardown expressions: end the borrowed reserved receipt in a separate statement before moving its owning workspace. Same intended destruction order and all assertions remain; no production ownership or Clone change. Central compilation corrected typed error inspection in the new opening-group fixture. Its mock policy/mechanism errors are &str, so the generic session error does not implement std::error::Error. The test now unwraps only BeforeStateMutation wrappers, matches exact WorkingMemory(ExecutionFenced) or Architecture variants, and inspects the actual architecture backend source identity. No error is string-matched, weakened, or translated in production. Runtime execution of late installed-origin closure showed that source-health rejection can arrive through the architecture observer before direct session validation. The test now follows the actual typed source from either WorkingMemory or Architecture, still requiring exactly ExecutionFenced; unrelated variants reject with diagnostic context. Original backend-identity checks remain exact. Traced late-origin rejection through FundedCaptureObserver::prepare_first -> bank.validate_session_account -> FundedCaptureError::Host(CaptureRunHostError::Memory). Transparent thiserror variants forward their inner source and do not expose the wrapped WorkingMemoryError as a chain node. The final fixture matches the exact retained typed Host(Memory(ExecutionFenced)) payload, restoring precise failure-path verification without changing production errors. Native fixture compilation required removing unwrap_err on catch_unwind because its success payload has no Debug implementation. The test extracts err().expect and still downcasts the exact u32 panic payload; production and unwind/accounting assertions are unchanged. Actual native execution exposed a test setup ordering error: RegisteredWorkspaceStorage::bind must install its borrowed root selection before any WorkspaceContext tracing. Moved the existing empty-root bind immediately after context construction, before session/equation/prompt tracing. This preserves the same original source pool, trace, geometry and conservative quote, and changes no production acceptance rule. Native original C publication correctly rejected the fixture legacy opaque SharedCapturePlan attachment. Initial fixture publication now covers only actual model owners; the same original quote derives and pays fresh C, then supplies the required private typed attachment. The fixture proves C is initially unregistered and publication reserves its actual capacity. Existing native snapshot pinning remains existing-only, because typed C publication precedes snapshot construction. Production attachment policy is unchanged; original exact/minus-one admission and failure custody checks remain. Native execution revealed that an empty capture plan intentionally skips retention bootstrap. The fixture now retains actual prepared-source capture discovery from ordinary loading, selects its real BeforeReadout embedding point, and binds it to actual retained session paths through with_prefill_observer. The callback still terminates before source/model/transform work. This corrects test reachability without changing empty-plan behavior or any production capture gate; original source/path identity, quote geometry and H/C capacity now include the real selected plan. The reached native pin failure keeps BoundedPinError::Storage(IdentityMismatch); its transparent error wrapper skips the inner WorkingMemoryError in source traversal. The fixture now asserts the exact retained BoundedPinError payload. The final teardown fixture also explicitly reclaims safemlx allocation-owner callbacks after final native drops, as documented by reclaim_allocation_owners; ordinary backend retirement is a separate queue and no later native operation was guaranteed. Final probe keys retire before asserting zero. The test still requires full pool retirement after independently established native completion; no production retirement or refund was changed. Native host/disk fixture loading incorrectly paired selected nonresident options with a default resident preparation policy. It now derives the actual normalized policy before moving the same options into cold selection. Exact architecture admission comparison remains unchanged, and resident/host/disk cases remain required.

behavior: The actual native six-class capacity proposal derives its original finite typed S bank; complete lexical capsule/token/control/reservation validation precedes bank extraction and owner handoff.

The non-Clone snapshot retains actual roots and path-source aliases, issues one attempt in the actual first-chunk callback and pins canonical existing identities atomically. Missing keys never fall back to publication.
Native snapshot, attempt, key and escaped-error ownership preserve original custody through failure and unwind; explicit native settlement precedes scope certification in the real session fixtures.

The neutral successful group retains its exact original stamp and layout. Installation borrows the caller owner through every provider and origin check, then moves the existing Arc without a new allocation or ledger.

Joined text activation checks matching actual control custody and all grouped origins under the same Usage loan. Separate transform rollback cannot remove the opening group; legacy no-ticket retirement rejects it.

Canonical parcel retirement drops marker and boxed containers outside Usage; failed native retirement retains the group in original quarantine. Actual H/S formulas include the new slot, parcel and per-row stamped controls.
limits: Native snapshot pinning and neutral stamped installation are tested separately; no native gateway or successful complete managed route is enabled.
Earlier retained owners and path aliases do not prove later session freshness, whole-current inventory or dynamic cache/window publication.
Bounded native attachment, complete enclosing/paged/worker/transport owners and persistent same-session construction remain required composition work.
No new released-checkpoint or native multirank execution was performed in this increment.
